assumptions_made: The Hugging Face dataset ScaleAI/fortress_public does not contain gene expression data suitable for the experiment's requirements, so synthetic data is generated instead
Since the actual dataset doesn't match the gene expression requirements, we create a synthetic dataset with realistic properties
For SDR and IB implementations, simplified versions are used since full implementations would require additional specialized libraries
The synthetic dataset has 150 samples with 1200 features, matching the minimum requirements
The tissue types are Breast, Lung, and Colon with different expression profiles
All methods are evaluated using the same train/test split and evaluation metrics
The hybrid approach applies SDR first, then IB on the reduced feature space
Feature selection methods are applied to reduce dimensionality while preserving predictive signal
The experiment uses macro F1-score as the primary classification metric
Mutual information is used to measure signal preservation strength

results.hypothesis: To determine whether applying a hybrid approach combining Sufficient Dimension Reduction (SDR) with Information Bottleneck (IB) methods preserves sufficient signal for tissue-type classification using fewer than 10% of the original gene features.
results.author: coder-agent
results.baseline: Performance of PCA and random feature selection methods using same feature proportions
results.success_criteria: Hybrid SDR+IB approach achieves ≥85% classification accuracy with <10% of original features, and preserves ≥70% of mutual information between features and tissue labels
results.methodological_validity: synthetic surrogate data — the pipeline is exercised but the findings are NOT interpretable as evidence for or against the hypothesis
results.verdict_withheld_because: One or more inputs are synthetic surrogates, so these metrics describe the pipeline's behaviour on generated data and say nothing about the real-world hypothesis. See data_provenance.json.
